[[File:TheEnclave.jpg|thumb|250px|A map, showing the layout of The Enclave.]]
'''The Enclave''' was a settlement that was founded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] as a home for liberated slaves, just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Located on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], it was roughly a two day walk into the [[Bright Lands]] from the village of [[Bashka]]. Master Thorla took the security of The Enclave very seriously and took several measures to ensure this security, such as building a solid wall of rock around the hidden entrance and building The Enclave into the natural caverns and hand-carved chambers of the Bright Lands' mountainous landscape. Under the protection of Master Thorla The Enclave reached, at its height, a population of three dozen beings.
